name: forgeathon-editor
description: VS Code editor client for the Forge-a-thon TrueForge agent.

commands.title: Forge-a-thon: Undo All Reviewed Changes of Last Turn

forge.trueforgeUrl.description: Local TrueForge server in the extension host environment.

forge.mcpPort.description: Loopback port used by the editor MCP server.

forge.context.semanticSearch.description: Opt-in local semantic reranking (CPU), used only when keyword/structure evidence is weak. Fully cached scores rerank at once; on a cache miss the turn uses the lexical/structural shortlist immediately and vectors warm in the background for later turns. Needs scripts/enable-semantic-search.sh (installs the runtime, about 230 MB); the embedding model onnx-community/all-MiniLM-L6-v2-ONNX (about 54 MB) downloads from Hugging Face on first use. Off by default.

forge.context.maskSecrets.description: Mask high-confidence credential shapes (provider API keys such as nvapi-/sk-/gsk_/ghp_, cloud tokens, PEM private keys, and the provider keys this process knows) in workspace text before it is sent to the model or stored in TrueForge traces: read_file, search results, gather_context, the selection and the context pack. Ordinary code such as SECRET_KEY = "dev" is sent unchanged. Applies after reconnect.

forge.autoApproveSafeCommands.description: Run the agent's test and status commands without asking: only pytest, python -m pytest, git status and git diff, with no shell operators. Each one is shown in the panel as "auto-approved". Every other command (including python -c and flask) and every edit still asks.

forge.commandBudget.agent.description: Most commands other than test runs the agent may run in one turn (asked or auto-approved). Further run_command calls are refused by the harness without asking, and the panel shows "command budget reached". Test runs have forge.testCommandBudget.agent.

forge.commandBudget.inline.description: Most commands an inline edit may run in one turn (the inline agent does not run commands today).

forge.testCommandBudget.agent.description: Most test runs (pytest, python -m pytest) the agent may make in one turn, counted separately from other commands, so a denied or extra command never uses up a test rerun. Further test runs are refused without asking ("test-command budget reached").

forge.testCommandBudget.inline.description: Most test runs an inline edit may make in one turn.

forge.watchdog.modelRequestSec.description: Seconds the model may stay silent while a request is in flight (a long edit can stream nothing for a while) before the turn is stopped as unresponsive. Other waits keep the 45 s limit. A stop after the turn changed files offers Resume.

forge.tools.multiRangeRead.markdownDescription: Let the agent read several line ranges of one file in one `read_file` call (fewer model round trips). Off by default: it changes the tool schema the model sees. Applies after reconnect.

forge.tools.editHints.markdownDescription: When a proposed edit's `old_text` matches nowhere, tell the agent where the closest text is and what it says now (up to 12 lines, credentials masked), so it can retry without another read. Off by default: it changes model-facing text. Applies after reconnect.
